prompts: I requested a password reset link yesterday. Can I still use it today?
I think it expired after 30 minutes, so I should request a new one. Will the old link work once I get a new link?

cards.label: Password reset links
cards.description: A password reset link expires after 30 minutes and works only once. Requesting a new link invalidates all previous reset links for the account. An expired or used link cannot change the password.
cards.objective: Explain when a password reset link can be used and when a new link is needed.
